description: Aimplan extends Power BI and Microsoft Fabric with Business and Financial Planning, Reporting, and Data Management. Power BI reports show what has already happened, but planning forward has traditionally meant leaving Power BI for Excel. The Aimplan Planning and Reporting Visual is built for FP&A teams, controllers, cost center owners, and project or sales managers who need to enter budgets, forecasts, and plans in the same place they already analyze actuals. Enter a number, press save, and it writes back to your existing semantic model immediately, updating every chart on the page. Allocate a high-level number down using your own Power BI measures, or start from last year's actuals or an AI-generated forecast. Scenarios such as budget and forecast versions live as a dimension in the model, and row-level security controls who sees and edits what. Because it runs on your existing semantic model, every data source Power BI already connects to comes with it. To learn more about Aimplan, visit www.aimplan.com or schedule a demo at https://www.aimplan.com/lm/bookdemo.
